rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for air, weather, ground, or anything noticeably damp or moist.

example.english: This room is a bit humid.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jau5 di1 ciu4 sap1

rows.note: Use this for hot, close, muggy humidity that feels stuffy, especially when describing the weather or a room.

example.english: The weather is really humid today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 guk6
